answer: An attacker minting thousands of cheap identities gains nothing because fake accounts holding only a sliver of jade-like token value sit on a narrow ledge of influence. Sybil resistance here works through stake-weighted identity: each agent must lock a bonded deposit tied to a unique hardware attestation, and voting power scales with stake, not headcount. Duplicate registrations are slashed, so a mass-forgery attempt costs real capital and collapses like a karst cavern under its own hollow weight. In practice, CursorComposer sees clones fail at the grading gate.
